affectedPublicSurfaces: None reachable by a user. Migration 038 adds five additive columns to tiktok_credentials, mirrors them onto the TikTokCredential ORM model, and adds three repository methods. No route, no asset, no frontend, no behavior change on any existing read path — ADR-081 decision 7 scopes this slice to persistence only, and #1231/#1232 are the first slices that write through it. publicRelease classification follows from the migration, not from a user-facing surface.

candidateVerificationJourney.restrictedRoute: Local tests on feature/issue-1230-credential-columns, cut from feature/agent-w4-wave. No VPS contact, no deployment, no vendor calls, no production database access.

journeys.name: additive-column-round-trip
assertions: alembic upgrade head and alembic downgrade -1 both round-trip cleanly against a seeded database, under the migration_heavy marker
ORM-vs-migration schema parity holds for all five new columns under the schema_parity marker
a row inserted through the ORM without setting status reads back 'active', and refresh_count reads back 0
a pre-migration-shaped row reads back None for last_refreshed_at, last_refresh_error and refresh_token_expires_at rather than a synthesized value
the mark-refreshed repo method increments refresh_count by exactly 1 and clears a previously-set last_refresh_error back to NULL
the mark-needs-reauth repo method sets status and leaves access_token, refresh_token and token_expires_at untouched
the scan method returns exactly the 1h and 20h rows for a 24h window against seeded rows at 1h/20h/48h — the gap-6 regression, written so it would fail against the old 30-minute REFRESH_BUFFER
the scan method excludes a status='needs_reauth' row whose token_expires_at is inside the window

htmlRoutes: No HTML route or asset changes — one migration, models.py, repos.py and their tests.

migrationCompatibility.notes: Revision 038 is assigned by Meta, not read from head: 037_required_steps_completed is on main as of 2026-08-20, and the issue body's 037 guess is stale. The revision id stays at or under 32 characters — a longer id commits fine and then fails at upgrade time with StringDataRightTruncation. All five columns are additive and either nullable or server-defaulted, with no backfill and no index (ADR-081 d.7 rejects an index at ~100 rows), so stable pods reading the old shape and candidate pods reading the new one coexist. status is a plain varchar checked in application code, following workflow_runs.status — no CREATE TYPE, so downgrade drops columns without an orphaned type. Deploy path is infra/scripts/safe-alembic-upgrade.sh. ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE_MIGRATION_TESTS is never set for this slice and must never be set against the production database.

rollbackAssertion.preCutoverFailureBehavior: Do not merge. Without this slice the five columns do not exist and #1231/#1232 cannot be written — the pre-existing state, in which nothing automatically refreshes a credential. No new exposure.
rollbackAssertion.postCutoverFailureBehavior: alembic downgrade -1 drops the five columns. Nothing reads or writes them at this point in the wave, so the downgrade is behavior-neutral by construction; revert the commit alongside it.

acceptanceCommands: PYTHONPATH=$PWD/backend/src python -m pytest tests/unit -q -k 'credential or tiktok_credential'
ruff check backend tests && ruff format --check backend/src/juli_backend/models/models.py backend/src/juli_backend/repositories/repos.py
doNotInfer: This slice adds columns and repo methods only. It does not refresh a credential, does not add a beat or a queue, and does not delete any of the three existing direct refresh call sites — those are #1231 and #1232.
refresh_token_expires_at is populated only if the vendor sends refresh_token_expire_in, which appears nowhere in the codebase, fixtures or docs today. Nothing may assume the column is ever non-null.
token_expires_at is not renamed to access_token_expires_at; ADR-081 d.7 rejects that rename explicitly.
